widgets.title: Job duration
widgets.query: SELECT run_date, duration_seconds FROM ops.pipeline_runs WHERE dag_id = 'fincore_daily_pipeline' AND run_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30 ORDER BY run_date

widgets.title: Record counts
widgets.query: SELECT run_date, total_trade_count AS total, clean_trade_count AS clean, rejected_trade_count AS rejected FROM ops.pipeline_runs WHERE dag_id = 'fincore_daily_pipeline' AND run_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30 ORDER BY run_date

widgets.title: Rejection rate
widgets.query: SELECT run_date, (reject_rate * 100) AS reject_percent FROM ops.pipeline_runs WHERE dag_id = 'fincore_daily_pipeline' AND run_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30 ORDER BY run_date

widgets.title: SLA compliance
widgets.query: SELECT bucket.label, count(runs.run_date) AS runs FROM (VALUES ('within SLA', true), ('missed SLA', false)) AS bucket(label, flag) LEFT JOIN ops.pipeline_runs AS runs ON runs.within_sla = bucket.flag AND runs.dag_id = 'fincore_daily_pipeline' AND runs.run_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30 GROUP BY bucket.label, bucket.flag ORDER BY bucket.flag DESC

widgets.title: dbt pass rate
widgets.query: SELECT run_date, CASE WHEN dbt_tests_passed THEN 100 ELSE 0 END AS pass_percent FROM ops.pipeline_runs WHERE dag_id = 'fincore_daily_pipeline' AND run_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30 ORDER BY run_date
